title: Beyond NL2Code: A Structured Survey of Multimodal Code Intelligence
abstract: arXiv:2606.15932v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have substantially advanced text-to-code generation, many real programming tasks specify intent through visual artifacts such as screenshots, charts, and videos. These tasks require models to connect visual perception to executable programs, as correctness depends not only on syntax but also on layout, data semantics, and domain-specific constraints that apply after execution. This survey reviews Multimodal Code Intelligence, covering systems that generate, edit, refine, or reason with code under visually grounded inputs and outputs. We first formulate the field by the role that code plays in each task, distinguishing code as a rendered artifact, an editable structure, an intermediate reasoning trace, or an executable tool interface. Then we organize benchmarks and methods into four domains: Graphical User Interface, Scientific Visualization, Structured Graphics, and Frontier Tasks and Frameworks. T

translated_title: 超越NL2Code：多模态代码智能的结构化综述
translated_abstract: 尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）在文本到代码生成方面取得了显著进展，但许多实际的编程任务是通过截图、图表和视频等视觉产物来指定意图的。这些任务要求模型将视觉感知与可执行程序联系起来，因为正确性不仅取决于语法，还取决于布局、数据语义以及执行后适用的领域特定约束。本综述回顾了多模态代码智能领域，涵盖了在视觉化输入和输出条件下生成、编辑、精炼或推理代码的系统。我们首先根据代码在每个任务中所扮演的角色来构建该领域的框架，将代码区分为渲染产物、可编辑结构、中间推理轨迹或可执行工具接口。然后我们将基准测试和方法组织为四个领域：图形用户界面、科学可视化、结构化图形以及前沿任务与框架。
tldr: 本综述首次系统性地构建了多模态代码智能领域的分类框架，根据代码在任务中的角色将其划分为渲染产物、可编辑结构、推理轨迹和工具接口四种类型，并从图形用户界面、科学可视化、结构化图形和前沿任务四个领域梳理了相关基准与方法。
en_tdlr: This survey establishes the first structured framework for Multimodal Code Intelligence, categorizing code by its role as a rendered artifact, editable structure, reasoning trace, or tool interface, and organizing benchmarks and methods across four domains: GUI, scientific visualization, structured graphics, and frontier tasks.
